debug.description: Stage override for the profile debug setting.

namespace.description: Overrides the project namespace for guide keys.

sourceDir.description: Pack-relative content root containing locale directories; defaults to guides inside each owner pack.

screensDir.description: Pack-relative directory inside the owner behavior pack scripts. Defaults to scripts/guides.

componentsModule.description: Pack-relative module default-exporting a guide component registry.

manifestPath.description: Optional pack-relative staged manifest output, outside the guide source directory. Normally owned by the per-pack generated artifact directory.

owner.description: Restrict guide compilation to one configured behavior or resource pack; otherwise discover content in every selected pack.

resourcePack.description: Direct local resource dependency receiving generated client content.
